parsed.rationale: The structural evidence shows `shared_field_count: 0` and a null Jaccard similarity, meaning the two protocols share no members by name. `AudioEnginePlayerProtocol` (11 members including `eventStream`, `installRenderTap`, `scheduleBuffer`, `volume`) operates at the AVAudioEngine/PCM-buffer layer, while `PlayerProtocol` (4 members: `pause`, `play`, `rate`, `replaceCurrentItem`) wraps AVPlayer item scheduling. Although both live in the `Playback` package, they model structurally and semantically distinct abstraction layers — one for low-level audio engine control and one for high-level radio player item management. Introducing a parent protocol with no shared members would add an empty abstraction that carries no reuse benefit and would misleadingly imply a substitutability relationship that does not exist.
